name: Probabilistic Occupancy Policy
definition: A policy for converting point cloud intensity values into occupancy status (FREE, OCCUPIED, UNKNOWN) based on proximity to 0.0 (FREE) or 1.0 (OCCUPIED) within a tolerance range.
summary: Probabilistic Occupancy Policy classifies point cloud intensity values as free or occupied using symmetric tolerance ranges around 0 and 1, unlike the Signed Intensity Policy which uses a single threshold near zero.
